title: fragaria ovalis
intro: Fragaria ovalis, commonly known as the beach strawberry or wild strawberry, is a species of flowering plant in the rose family that is native to coastal areas. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including alleviating digestive issues and providing relief from respiratory problems due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The health benefits of Fragaria ovalis are attributed to its high content of vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants, which have therapeutic actions such as reducing oxidative stress, improving gut health, and protecting against infections. The bioactive constituents of Fragaria ovalis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and ascorbic acid, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
